scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace backend && node scripts/migrate-local.mjs
scripts.build: npm run tokens:check && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run tokens:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.infra:up: npm run preflight && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.stack:up: npm run preflight && docker compose --profile apps up -d --build --wait
